mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "O" marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes. Right image: The symbol "O" marks the center of the indicated circle.
Rationales: The left occurrence is O at the meeting of the horizontal x and vertical h axes. The right occurrence is O beneath the dot at the center, above the horizontal chord. The left placement shows that the symbol marks the origin at the intersection of the coordinate axes, while the right placement shows that it marks the center of the indicated circle.
